pin.title: Does Oily Skin Need Moisturizer?
pin.sub: Why Korean routines still hydrate shiny skin

steps.title: Oil isn't hydration
steps.body: Shine comes from oil; hydration is about water. Oily skin can still feel tight or dull without a moisturizing step.

steps.title: Go light
steps.body: Choose a gel, light lotion or watery emulsion and apply one thin layer after toner, morning and night.

pin.note: Tip: if a texture feels heavy, try a gel version of the same step.
